review_method: Inspected three final full-resolution PNGs, sampled first/middle/final decoded MP4 frames and first/middle/final GIF frames.
checks: Organization metadata inventory, pending acceptance and withdrawn receipt are legible.
Hong Kong timestamps show time-of-day for dispatch/expiry and journal history.
The manual withdrawal preserves original acceptance and shows no run link.
No password, MFA secret, private capability, request prose or real business records are visible.
Actual post-authentication MP4 pixels and labelled three-screenshot-tour GIF keep distinct claims.
